name: fiber-lsp-sdk
description: TypeScript SDK for Fiber LSP tenant registration, channel management, payments, and recovery.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p examples/tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.tooling.json
scripts.example: pnpm run build && tsc -p examples/tsconfig.browser.json && node examples/server/index.ts
scripts.format: prettier --write src scripts wasm examples test tsconfig*.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src scripts wasm examples test tsconfig*.json
